settings.headline: Every lesson, one membership.
settings.subtitle: Free preview lessons are open to everyone. Members unlock the full catalog and a personal dashboard to track progress.

steps.title: Every lesson
steps.body: All 35 lessons across seven courses, including exercises and quizzes, with new courses each season.

steps.title: My learning
steps.body: A personal dashboard with every course, your progress and a one-click way to resume your last lesson.

steps.title: Practical work
steps.body: Exercises built around real tasks, so you can use what you learned with your team the same week.

items.q: How do I become a member?
items.a: Most members join through their company's team plan. If your team does not have one yet, email hello@example.com and we will set you up. Atlas is a demo, so no payment is taken anywhere on this site.

items.q: What can I watch without signing in?
items.a: The first lesson of every course, and a second lesson in some courses. They are listed together on the Free lessons page.
When you mark a lesson complete, the progress is saved in your browser. Your dashboard reads it to show how far you are through each course.
Not yet. Certificates for completed courses are on the roadmap for next season.

settings.headline: Ready when you are.
settings.subtitle: Start with a free lesson today, and sign in whenever your membership is ready.
